import pytest
from service import evaluate

def test_bounded_literal_input():
    assert evaluate('[1, 2]') == [1, 2]

def test_function_call_is_rejected():
    with pytest.raises((ValueError, SyntaxError)):
        evaluate("__import__('os').getcwd()")
